elevate.move: Give the mono one job only: the elevation/benchmark system (EL. pills, BM numbers, rail). Every other label (kicker lines, legend, field labels, Sample tags, step labels) moves to Figtree small caps or sentence case, so the mono reads as the survey instrument and not as decoration on every surface

When the real library lands, make the photos plates in the same survey sequence: finished-driveway and rebar photos as pine-to-granite-red duotones masked in the existing crop-mark frames with contour lines over them, so BM-02 to BM-04 run drawing, drawing, real slab. The homeowner finally sees a finished pour in the brand's own ink
